metadata.description: Off-screen Claude Code session context for the localvoxtral dictation app.

plugins.name: localvoxtral
plugins.description: Publishes Claude Code session context (prompt, cwd, recent files) to a local localvoxtral socket so dictation can ground technical terms. Install this on the machine running localvoxtral. Fail-open: does nothing when the app is not running.

plugins.name: localvoxtral-remote
plugins.description: Publishes Claude Code session context from a remote host to localvoxtral on your Mac over an SSH RemoteForward tunnel. Install this on the REMOTE host, not the Mac. Declarative HTTP hooks only — no binary, no shell shim, no dependencies. Fail-open: does nothing without a tunnel.
